definitions.explanation: The head of a university or college, responsible for its overall administration and academic leadership.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学長|がくちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The university president gave an opening address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{学長|がくちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
{学長|がくちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新入生|しんにゅうせい}→新入生：03073_shinnyuusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歓迎|かんげい}した→歓迎する：26997_kangeisuru⟧。
examples.english: The president welcomed the new students at the entrance ceremony.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (learning, school) + {長|ちょう} (head, chief). Specifically the head of a university, as distinct from the head of a lower school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学長|がくちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take office as university president
- {学長|がくちょう}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: election for university president

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧: principal — head of an elementary, junior high, or high school
- {総長|そうちょう}: president — used by some large universities in place of {学長|がくちょう}
- ⟦{学部長|がくぶちょう}→学部長：24823_gakubuchou⟧: dean — head of a single faculty, below the {学長|がくちょう}
